title: Master of the fleet
name: Epicadus the Liburnian
voice: A weathered Illyrian sailor; blunt, superstitious about the sea.
ability_text: Sails one convoy in winter, when the sea is closed to everyone else.
notes: DRAFT name. Epicadus is an attested Illyrian name. The Liburnians gave Rome its light galley, the liburna.

title: Prefect of the auxiliaries
name: Marcus Antistius
voice: A Roman career officer; dry, practical, wants his men paid on time.
ability_text: Turns a narrowly failed battle roll: +2 to the die after it is rolled.
notes: DRAFT name. Commands the town's auxiliary garrison.

title: Adviser on trade
name: Nikandros of Epidaurum
voice: A Greek merchant from the coast; clever, always has a deal.
ability_text: One convoy trades at a better price: +20% on what it buys or sells.
notes: DRAFT name. Greek traders were long established on the Adriatic coast.

title: Keeper of the treasury
name: Felix
voice: A careful freedman; counts every denarius, dreads the tribute.
ability_text: When the chest is short, writes to Rome and delays the tribute by one season without penalty.
notes: DRAFT name. Treasuries were often run by a dispensator, a trusted slave or freedman.

title: Haruspex
name: Tertius Volusius
voice: Reads the gods' will in omens; calm, dramatic in bad years.
ability_text: Sees the season's omen before it is turned over; you may ask him to sacrifice again and draw another.
notes: DRAFT name. Haruspices read the livers of sacrificed animals, a craft Rome took from the Etruscans.
